verdict.rationale: Feitian documents biometric (fingerprint) on-device user verification for BioPass keys, explicitly noting 'losing the key will cause no security risk at all,' and separately documents FIDO PIN management via iePassManager for PIN/credential operations, satisfying the on-device UV requirement. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of PIN enforcement or biometric FAR/FRR, and no explicit CTAP2 'uv' flag documentation.
